svg.title: Ring Road layout
svg.text: RING ROAD · Ring Road · 104x58 tiles · road 5.5 tiles wide
Lap 223 tiles = 28,586 px · about 34 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 11.8 tiles
Glowing path = star lane (full speed). Starry space = dust (slower). Clouds / moon = slowest. Pale stretch = slippery ice.
Beacons light the tight bends. Grey rocks on dashes = drifting asteroids. Yellow streak = comet path. Orange = boost. Rock ring = wall.
Gold dashes = Inner Ring: 53 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 48 tiles of main lane
Gold dashes = Moon Loop: 46 tiles, 4 wide, instead of 41 tiles of main lane
